about: The reviewed exceptions to the names that must be absent from the glue (engine/build/tools/wasm-inspect.mjs, glueChecks; docs/DEVELOPING.md, "The TeX engine: our own build"). Each entry names one glue by its SHA-256, a line and a text, and must lie inside a comment; a new glue, or a watched name anywhere else, fails the build until an entry is reviewed and added here, so a new comment is a reviewed change. Ours (the liveMd2Tex authors), GPL-3.0-or-later.

entries.reason: a comment Emscripten 6.0.13 keeps in the -g1 glue, on the file system's per-node wait queue ("producers (SOCKFS, PIPEFS) call notifyListeners"); the glue defines no SOCKFS object (var SOCKFS is absent), and a comment cannot run
